coaching.headline: Four straight won fights with one allied death closed the game, after two of three lost fights gave up Fangtooth and two towers.

flags.text: Wins got cashed: five of seven won fights became a prize within 90 seconds.
Sparrow did the damn carrying from support: 30595 hero damage, the most of all ten players.
Greystone and Yurei killed Crunch and Zinx on the offlane while Legion and Sparrow were still dead.
The shit stretch: Boris scored four of the seven allied deaths across the three lost fights.

focus.title: Rotate the open lanes
focus.action: Once the enemy duo and offlane outer towers are down, Legion and Greystone treat every fight on mid and at the Fangtooth pit as a rotation call.

20.3.call: Lost 1-3 after Neon's kill on Argus: Yurei and Sparrow died in the enemy jungle, Neon in the allied jungle, then the enemy took Fangtooth and the allied mid outer. After the first allied death, regroup before the pit.

25.1.call: Two separate plays: Greystone, Yurei and Sparrow scored three kills on the mid lane and in the enemy base, and Crunch killed Legion on the duo lane. Sparrow then razed the mid inner, the right follow-up.

27.3.call: Won 3-0 at the Fangtooth pit and took Fangtooth, and Crunch razed the allied offlane outer in the same window. Fair trade: three kills and Fangtooth for one tower, and Shaper followed.

28.6.call: Won 5-0 with Shaper already taken: Legion opened on Boris, Neon killed Crunch and TwinBlast in the enemy base, and the Core fell seconds after the last kill. Ace plus Shaper means the base, every time.

6d0a1d9c-d093-4395-9729-5d6ad7d2da91: Six deaths against a 4.875 norm: three to Argus on the mid lane, two outside any detected fight. Dodge Dread Nova, the only Argus stun, before committing to a trade.
Last hits on the mid inhibitor and Core; 855 hero damage per minute against a 682 norm. Raise 7.9 CS per minute toward the 9.1 norm.
cbc28e22-71ce-45b9-8f67-49b78cb86ff7: Game-high 16398 gold off 11.6 CS per minute against an 8.6 norm, and three kills on Boris, including the opener of the closing ace. Keep that farm pace.
Two of three deaths came on the duo lane in the enemy half, to Boris and Crunch. With Boris or Crunch missing from the map, push only behind a ward.
2e777887-5111-46b4-96d5-1eb5fae5ba0f: Razed three structures, the duo outer and inner plus the mid inner, and took the last hit on Shaper, with 62% kill participation. Keep hitting towers after every won fight.
Three of four deaths went to Boris, one before minute ten. Back off from Primeval Roar until the barrier explodes, and stay behind the frontline against Ursine Burst.
a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Game-high 39086 mitigated damage and 21158 healing, six kills against two deaths: the frontline a no-tank draft needed. In the next no-tank draft, take the same frontline job.
Last hits on a Mini Prime and the closing Fangtooth, on a best spree of six. After a won fight near a pit, call the take.
1d480695-bb6d-4bf8-a009-6217fb69135b: Two deaths against a norm above five, eight wards against a norm of two, and the second Mini Prime last hit. Keep warding before every objective.
Boris took 59 minions from the allied jungle against 15 taken back, and scored both kills on this jungler. When Boris shows on a far lane, invade.

matchup: Argus dealt 12960 magical damage to heroes; 9704 of the 15580 hero damage taken here was magical.
Field record into Argus for this mid: 47.3% across 271 games.
build: Combustion and Wraith Leggings match the 58.1% core; Amulet Of Chaos is the off-core third item.
Amulet Of Chaos cuts current basic ability cooldowns and restores missing mana on each takedown.
Wraith Leggings adds 12% ability damage against heroes below 40% health.
eternal: Vesh repeats a share of ability damage on heroes as damage over time.
Lotus is the clear Best in this mid field; Vesh ranks last among Eternals with enough games.
Under Vesh, The Tenth Seal with Phylactery tops the pairs; Tithe of Death with Millennia trails.
augment: Ghost in the Machine grants brief invisibility after the Erase Vector dash.
Dox and RAM lead a toss-up in this mid field; Ghost in the Machine ranks third.
crest: Epoch's Stasis Device active enters Stasis; Epoch evolves from Wizard Crest.
Time-Flux Band leans ahead of Soulbearer in this mid field; Epoch, the most played, ranks behind the two.
improvement: Unbuilt needs: tenacity (World Breaker), anti-heal (Tainted Scepter) against Zinx, Crunch and Boris, and magical armor against Argus.
World Breaker over Amulet Of Chaos: 25 tenacity and 350 health into Dread Nova, losing the takedown cooldown cut.
Lotus over Vesh is the field-backed Eternal swap.

matchup: Duo lane against TwinBlast and Zinx: one duo death each before minute ten, and the first Fangtooth went allied.
TwinBlast scored one kill here, outside any detected fight; Zinx finished 0/5/0.
Field record into TwinBlast: 52.3% across 1408 games.
build: Malady and Spear Of Desolation match the 54.5% most-played core into TwinBlast; Deathstalker was the missing piece.
The Perforator ignores 30% of physical armor, useful into Crunch, the top enemy mitigator.
eternal: Thraex marks the last hero hit by a basic attack: more damage dealt to, and less taken from, that hero.
Xyris leans first in this carry field; Thraex, the most played, ranks sixth among Eternals with enough games.
Savage Strikes with Rallying Roar is the top Thraex pair. Sound keep on the minors.
augment: Scorched Earth leaves Napalm zones where Frag Order and Saturation Charge Mines explode, and along Orbital Sanction.
Scorched Earth is the clear Best in this carry field. Sound keep.
crest: Ortus's Limit Breaker grants movement speed and physical power; takedowns inside the window add permanent physical power.
Witchstalker leans narrowly ahead of Ortus in this carry field; Ortus evolves from Assassin Crest.
improvement: Unbuilt need: anti-heal (Tainted Rounds) against Zinx, Crunch and Boris, with Boris healing 18148.
Tainted Rounds over Mutilator gives up omnivamp to cut a target's healing by 45% on basic attack hits.
Xyris over Thraex is the field-backed Eternal test, trading Savage Strikes healing for bonus damage.

matchup: Zinx placed 8 wards to 5 here, and this support cleared zero enemy wards.
The duo-lane death before minute ten came from Boris, not the lane pair.
Draft read: a damage pick at support, so no peel stays with Legion.
build: Sky Splitter's Rend deals a share of the target's current health on each basic attack hit.
Storm Breaker stores Momentum while moving or attacking, then chains a lightning bolt to seven targets.
Lightning Hawk and Tainted Rounds from the 56.1% winning core never made the build.
eternal: Weald fires true-damage missiles at heroes below 30% health; Forage adds gold and XP per minion or monster kill.
Weald leans first in this thin support field. Sound keep; Forage and Wind-Rider are the most-picked minors.
augment: Sun Shards makes basic attacks ricochet, applying on-hit effects at 35% effectiveness.
Inner Fury leans ahead of Sun Shards in this support field.
crest: Eviscerator's active adds attack speed, omnivamp and empowered basic attacks; Eviscerator evolves from Sharpshooter Crest.
Leafsong is the only crest with enough games in this support field: most played, no edge; Eviscerator sits below the floor.
improvement: Unbuilt needs: tenacity (Equinox), anti-heal (Tainted Rounds) and physical armor against Boris.
Tainted Rounds over Spectra gives up attack speed and ability haste, but basic attack hits cut Boris's healing by 45%.
Inner Fury over Sun Shards trades ricochet basic attacks for a wider, longer Inner Fire.

matchup: Offlane opponent Crunch: two kills on Crunch, one death to Crunch, the first blood.
Boris took the other death, outside any detected fight in the allied jungle.
Field record into Crunch: 52.2% across 527 games.
build: Overlord, Rapture and Aegis Of Agawar is the full winning core, bought in that order.
Aegis Of Agawar raises the armor bonus from 10% to 20% below 40% health.
Fire Blossom, bought last, adds 50 physical armor against three physical damage dealers.
eternal: Krix adds max health and size; Cannibalism adds 25 max health per takedown.
Nihil leans first in this offlane field; Krix ranks second.
Under Krix, Voracity with Cannibalism tops the pairs, ahead of the Regenerative Tissue run.
augment: Tainted Oath makes Sacred Oath apply Blight to enemies.
Imperial Soul leans narrowly ahead of Tainted Oath in this offlane field.
crest: Saphir's Mantle's Atlas active grows size and max health, hits nearby heroes, then permanently adds max health from the damage dealt.
Saphir's Mantle leads a toss-up with Eviscerator and Iceskorn Talons in this offlane field. Sound keep.
improvement: Field buys Tainted Guard into Crunch 21% of the time against a usual 11%; not built here.
Unbuilt needs: tenacity (Salvation) and anti-heal (Tainted Blade); Tainted Guard over Fire Blossom keeps armor and adds a healing cut.
Imperial Soul over Tainted Oath is the field lean, giving up Blight for more Stone Forged Soul damage and radius.

matchup: Jungle opponent Boris finished 9/8/2; the one Boris death credited here came at the Fangtooth pit.
Gank kills: Crunch twice on the offlane, Zinx three times across the duo lane, offlane and mid lane.
Field record into Boris: 48.9% across 153 games.
build: Tainted Blade met the anti-heal need: physical damage cuts a target's healing by 45%.
Mindrazor, Infernum and The Perforator, the 63.6% core, never made the build.
Spear Of Desolation adds 25 Ultimate Haste toward Soulstorm, the pull ultimate.
eternal: Lotus grants a random small stat every two minutes and on each takedown.
Lotus leans first in this jungle field. Sound keep; Early Bloom with Prima Donna is the top Lotus pair.
augment: Hallowed Reverberation gives Hallowed Strikes more range and two more bounces.
Ephemeral Surge leans ahead in this jungle field; Hallowed Reverberation, the most played, ranks second.
crest: Nex's Reap active dashes, hits nearby heroes, adds stored Sow damage and slows; Nex evolves from Assassin Crest.
Nex, the most played, ranks near the bottom of this jungle field; Witchstalker leads a toss-up with Judgement and Ortus.
improvement: Tainted Blade covered anti-heal; armor went unbuilt, so add one armor item when a three-physical enemy comp drafts again.
Witchstalker over Nex is the field-backed crest swap: a cleanse and max-health hit in place of Reap.
Early Bloom with Prima Donna: a level and 10% hero damage, for 6% more damage taken and no ally healing.

threats: Chain-CC risk (1 hard-CC abilities, ~1.3s of lockdown): Crunch Right Crunch (knockup 1.25s). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Dive threat on our backline: Crunch. Assign peel for the carry and ward the flanks.
synergy: Little hard CC on our side — we can't force a pick. Play for poke/objectives and punish their cooldowns, don't flip coin-toss 5v5s.
Our damage is 4/5 physical — predictable; the enemy itemizes one armor item against most of it. A magical pick would split their defenses.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Cast basic abilities to build 3 Thread, then Overclock Data Burst to slow and Mesmerize, follow with L.I.N.X true damage and an Erase Vector dash into the exploding Jolt; Final Thread Overclocks everything and its recast bomb finishes low targets.
ourKits.winCondition: Chunk enemies with Overclocked abilities in lane and teamfights, then use Final Thread to chain several Overclocked casts and execute with the bomb.
ourKits.passive: Neural Network: every 3 basic ability casts Overclock her next basic ability for an extra effect.
ourKits.playWith: Frontliners or engage supports who keep enemies in Data Burst range and give her time to cycle Thread.
ourKits.playAgainst: Watch her Thread count and respect the next ability when she is at 3, since Overclocked Data Burst Mesmerizes. Dodge the lobbed Data Burst before it detonates, and engage after Erase Vector is spent, which is her only dash. Magic armor helps but L.I.N.X return and pulse are true damage.

ourKits.combo: Saturation Charge mines to slow, Frag Order to launch enemies, Orbital Sanction to track them, Rally Point to knock back divers and heal allies.
ourKits.winCondition: Hold an area with Orbital Sanction and mines while Rally Point keeps his team healthy and his rifle on infinite ammo.
ourKits.passive: Ballistic Calibration turns bonus attack speed into ability haste and unlocks ability upgrades at item stat thresholds.
ourKits.playWith: Frontliners who fight inside Rally Point's heal and hold enemies in the Orbital beam.
ourKits.playAgainst: Stun him while he cooks Frag Order to make him drop it. Bait Rally Point's knockback before engaging, trade when he reloads, and buy anti-heal against Rally Point's heal and armor against his physical damage.

ourKits.combo: Piercing Shot poke → Heightened Senses for attack speed → Hail of Arrows slow → Inner Fire barrage
ourKits.winCondition: stack Relentless with basics and abilities to add max-health damage and melt the frontline in long fights
ourKits.passive: Relentless stacks on hit and makes her basics deal bonus max-health damage
ourKits.playWith: peel and a frontline, since her only escape is a short stealth
ourKits.playAgainst: Heightened Senses is her only escape, a brief stealth with speed and no dash, so hard-engage her after it is used; Piercing Shot passes through terrain, so do not hide behind walls at low health

ourKits.combo: Assault The Gates leap in, Make Way to shred armor, Sacred Oath empowered cleave to slow, then Stone Forged Soul to heal in Stasis and crash down.
ourKits.winCondition: Stay in the middle of fights and use Stone Forged Soul's missing-health heal to reset, while Make Way shreds armor for the team.
ourKits.passive: Stoicism deflects the next basic attack on a cooldown and grants health regen and armor that grow as he loses health.
ourKits.playWith: Damage dealers who can follow his leap and benefit from Make Way's armor shred.
ourKits.playAgainst: Do not burst into Stone Forged Soul's Stasis; step away from the slow and the crash, then re-engage. Open with an ability since Stoicism deflects a basic, and buy anti-heal to cut the ult heal.

ourKits.combo: Whispering Echoes or Anima Burst apply Soul Rip → Severance resets on Soul Rip targets → Soulstorm pulls them in and resets Severance
ourKits.winCondition: chain Severance resets off Soul Rip to stick to a target and burst in melee
ourKits.passive: casting an ability makes her next two basics ranged, faster and bouncing
ourKits.playWith: follow-up CC to hold the target she dashes onto
ourKits.playAgainst: her chain needs Soul Rip to reset Severance, so dodge Whispering Echoes and punish when Severance is on cooldown; walk out of Soulstorm before its pull, and buy anti-heal against Anima Burst

enemyKits.combo: Vortex Grenade slow → Vaporize pierce → Rocket Dash reposition → Ventilate barrage
enemyKits.winCondition: weave abilities for Gunslinger triple-shots and keep Rocket Dash up by hitting heroes
enemyKits.passive: casting an ability grants attack speed and makes the next basic fire three times
enemyKits.playWith: a frontline that creates space for him to keep shooting
enemyKits.playAgainst: Rocket Dash is his only escape and comes back faster when he hits heroes, so engage right after he uses it; Ventilate is a short channel worth interrupting

enemyKits.combo: Ricochet stun chain → Bad Medicine slows → basics to proc Triage Protocol → Infuse heal → Neural Regenesis on the ally about to die
enemyKits.winCondition: keep allies alive with Infuse and Neural Regenesis while Ricochet stuns open picks
enemyKits.passive: damaging heroes builds Triage Protocol; at max it gives decaying speed and stronger Infuse
enemyKits.playWith: a carry she can pocket-heal and revive
enemyKits.playAgainst: Infuse is aimed at allies, so dive her; bait Neural Regenesis before committing burst, avoid grouping in Ricochet's bounce chain, and buy anti-heal

enemyKits.combo: Forward Crunch dashes in to stun, Left Crunch and Right Crunch build Turbo, then the Turbo Crunch version (long push dash, true-damage double swipe, or knockup uppercut) lands, with Re-Crunch repeating the last ability
enemyKits.winCondition: chain abilities into Turbo Crunch empowered hits and heal through Re-Crunch's passive
enemyKits.passive: each ability empowers his next basic attack and cuts his cooldowns; two ability casts activate Turbo Crunch, enhancing his next basic ability
enemyKits.playWith: engage and peel-stripping teammates so he can reach the backline
enemyKits.playAgainst: fight after Forward Crunch is used, since it is his long-cooldown gap closer; respect his second ability cast because the next one is Turbo-enhanced; anti-heal blunts Re-Crunch healing and armor helps against his physical damage

enemyKits.combo: Ether Crystal pushes then implodes to pull enemies together, Dread Nova stuns the group, Particle Shredder homes in, then Synaptic Obliterator beams finish low targets
enemyKits.winCondition: poke from long range, zone with Ether Crystal and land Dread Nova stuns into Obliterator beams
enemyKits.passive: abilities apply Disintegration stacks that make further ability hits deal more damage
enemyKits.playWith: a frontline to protect him while he channels Synaptic Obliterator
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge Dread Nova, his only stun; dive him during the Synaptic Obliterator channel when he is immobile, and keep health high since beams hit harder on missing health; magic armor blunts his damage

enemyKits.combo: Detection Protocol marks and tracks a hero, Chrono Swipe dashes in to consume the Mark for a slow and a Canister, Primeval Roar gives damage reduction then fears, and Ursine Burst grabs and slams the target
enemyKits.winCondition: track a target out of position, then grab and slam them for the kill
enemyKits.passive: every second basic attack grants Canisters for attack speed and on-hit healing; at max Canisters his Tesseract Core zaps and heals
enemyKits.playWith: a team that collapses on the hero he grabs
enemyKits.playAgainst: Ursine Burst hovers briefly before the dash, so sidestep it or stay behind your frontline; back off from Primeval Roar until it explodes to avoid the fear; fight after Detection Protocol is spent; anti-heal trims his Canister healing

Matched or beat their tank heroes in the draft (0 v 0).
2 divers (Greystone, Yurei): each one past the first is a hero not holding the line.
4 of 5 deal physical damage: one armor item blunts most of it.
Sparrow at support is a damage pick: nobody stays with the carry.

plays.when: when one of them is alone or out of position in fog

playbook.note: No tank, engage hero or area crowd control to open a fight: play for picks, or let them engage first and counter after their CC is spent.

loadout.name: Savage Shred
loadout.text: Detection Protocol's Mark Shreds 35% Physical Armor for 5s when consumed.

ability.name: Detection Protocol
ability.what: Boris sniffs the air, Marking a nearby Enemy Hero and generating a Scent Trail to their location for 8s.

loadout.plain: Hitting your Detection Protocol target shreds their armor for a few seconds. Mark a squishy, run the trail to them, and your whole combo hits harder.

loadout.name: Weald
loadout.text: Damaging an Enemy Hero below 30% Health fires 4 (+1 per 30% Bonus Attack Speed) projectiles that each deal 7 (+1 per level) True Damage. Missiles travel through walls and disappear after 3000u. 10s cooldown per Hero. On-hit effects apply at 20% effectiveness.
loadout.plain: When you damage a hero below 30% health, true-damage missiles fly at them through walls. Canister attack speed adds more missiles, so it helps finish runners.

loadout.name: Forage
loadout.text: Gain 3 additional Gold and 3 additional XP per Minion or Monster kill.
loadout.plain: Each minion or monster kill gives 3 extra gold and 3 extra experience, so Boris levels and buys items a little faster from jungle clears. A plain income boost with no link to the kit.

loadout.name: Barkskin
loadout.text: Deal 3 (+1 per Level) Physical Damage to Enemy Heroes that Basic Attack you, triggering On-Hit effects at 50% effectiveness.
loadout.plain: Enemy heroes that basic attack Boris take 3 (+1 per level) physical damage, which also triggers Boris's on-hit effects at 50% effectiveness. Strongest against basic attackers while Primeval Roar's barrier cuts the damage coming in.

loadout.name: Eviscerator
loadout.text: Rending Strikes:  Gain 20% Attack Speed and 8% Omnivamp for 6s. Empower your Basic Attacks to deal (+10%) Damage On-Hit for 6s.
loadout.plain: Pop it when you commit: faster attacks, healing from your damage, and stronger basic attacks. Helps you reach max Canisters quickly.

evidence: 5/4/11, 30595 hero damage, the most in the game.

bullets: Every second basic attack on heroes or monsters built Tesseract Device canisters for attack speed and healing, Sky Splitter added current-health damage, and Ashbringer cut Chrono Swipe cooldowns.
Weald fired true-damage missiles whenever Boris damaged a hero below a health threshold, once per hero per cooldown; attack speed from Tesseract Device canisters could add missiles.
Barkskin hit back at enemy heroes who basic attacked Boris, triggering on-hit effects at reduced strength; Forage added gold and XP per minion or monster kill.
Every item carried ability haste, and Timewarp shaved non-ultimate cooldowns on a timer, so Dread Nova's stun and Ether Crystal's pull came back sooner.
Demiurge raised base item stats and Crescelia's empowered hit damage; Construct gave health and ability haste per level; Bloatware gave damage and damage reduction per item.
Dread Nova or Ether Crystal casts empowered the next basic attack within 4s via Crescelia, on a short cooldown, paying gold on hero hits; Alternator boosted Particle Shredder.
